params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''K'Sante's''' {{tip|abilities}} mark enemies hit for 4 seconds. His {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} against marked enemies are empowered to consume the mark, dealing {{as|12|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{pplevel|1 to 2|key=%}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}. The damage based on the target's health ratio deals a minimum of {{pplevel|10 + 5*x}} against {{tip|minion|minions}} and is capped at {{pplevel|15 + 5*x}} against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.
params.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|All Out|K'Sante|All Out}} Bonus:}} '''K'Sante's''' basic attacks and {{tip|ability damage}}, as well as ''Dauntless Instinct's'' mark consumption, are empowered to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|1% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|(+ 1% per 100 '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}.
params.notes:
* The mark deals {{tip|proc damage}} in sequence after the basic attack.
** This causes effects like {{ri|Bone Plating}} to be triggered an extra time.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the mark's application, but not the mark's consumption from an attack.
* The empowered attack can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}}, and missed while {{tip|blind|blinded}} but the mark will not be consumed.
* Starting the empowered attack while the mark is about to time out will not extend the mark duration, but still complete the attack and apply the bonus damage.
* All Out's bonus damage on abilities only applies to the first target hit when damaging multiple enemies (including minions and monsters).{{bug}}
** For most of '''K'Sante's''' spells and item effects, in the case of multiple targets being stuck on the same game tick, this refers to the closest target. For non-missile {{ai|Ntofo Strikes|K'Sante}}, it instead depends on the order in which the target units were spawned into the match.{{bug}}
* All Out's bonus damage amps the benefiting damage instance without applying an extra damage instance.
** This causes effects like {{ri|Bone Plating}} to not be triggered an extra time.
params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|K'Sante}} {{tip|abilities}} mark enemies hit for a short time. His {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} consume the mark to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{ai|All Out|K'Sante|All Out}} Bonus:}} K'Sante's basic attacks and abilities are empowered to deal {{as|'''additional bonus''' physical damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}, increased based on '''K'Sante's''' '''bonus''' {{as|armor}} and {{as|magic resist}}.

description.plain: Innate: K'Sante's abilities mark enemies hit for 4 seconds. His basic attacks against marked enemies are empowered to consume the mark, dealing 12 (+ 1% – 2% (based on level) of target's maximum health) bonus physical damage. The damage based on the target's health ratio deals a minimum of 15 – 100 (based on level) against minions and is capped at 20 – 105 (based on level) against monsters.

description3.plain: All Out Bonus: K'Sante's basic attacks and ability damage, as well as Dauntless Instinct's mark consumption, are empowered to deal bonus physical damage equal to 1% (+ 1% per 100 bonus armor) (+ 1% per 100 bonus magic resistance) of the target's maximum health.

blurb.plain: Innate: K'Sante abilities mark enemies hit for a short time. His basic attacks on-hit consume the mark to deal bonus physical damage based on the target's maximum health.

blurb4.plain: All Out Bonus: K'Sante's basic attacks and abilities are empowered to deal additional bonus physical damage based on the target's maximum health, increased based on K'Sante's bonus armor and magic resist.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''K'Sante''' {{tip|root|roots}} the target enemy {{tip|champion}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.5}} seconds|Duration unaffected by tenacity}} and gains {{tip|displacement immunity}} over the cast time. He then shatters his ntofos, {{tip|airborne|pulling}} the target to a location that is 300 units in the cast direction from their location at the time of cast, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}, and {{tip|blink|blinking}} {{tt|175 units|Beyond the target's hitbox's edge}} behind that location. The target is dealt {{as|physical damage}} near the end of the displacement and is {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.3}} seconds once it ends.
params.description2: If there is {{tt|valid map-generated terrain|Terrain that has an opposite side (non-border) and is not player-generated.}} 350 units in the cast direction from the target's location at the time of cast, the target is instead {{tip|airborne|pulled}} to a location that is directly 450 units away from the edge of the other side of the terrain and '''K'Sante''' {{tip|blink|blinks}} 100 units behind that location, dealing them the {{as|physical damage}} near their emergence from the terrain. At the end of the displacement, they remain {{tip|airborne}} for {{rutngt|0.25}}, after which they are {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. '''K'Sante''' strikes them after {{rutngt|0.125}} into the airborne duration to deal {{as|physical damage}}.

params.description3: After '''K'Sante''' {{tip|blink|blinks}}, he enters ''All Out'' for 15 seconds.
params.description4:
{{sbc|All Out:}} '''K'Sante''' gains a [[Health#Health_threshold|health threshold]] equal to {{sti|{{as|65% '''maximum''' health}}}} which cannot be {{tt|modified|By increases or decreases to maximum health}} nor {{tt|exceeded|By healing and health regeneration}} by any means. Upon entering ''All Out'', his {{as|'''current''' health}} is reduced to this threshold if it is above it. Additionally, his {{sti|armor|{{as|'''base''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''base''' magic resistance}}}} are reduced by {{as|85% '''bonus''' armor}} and {{as|85% '''bonus''' magic resistance}}, respectively. In return, he gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, {{sti|lethality|{{as|50% {{tt|'''bonus'''-armor penetration|Affects bonus armor only}}}}}}, and {{sti|{{as|20% omnivamp}}}}, and modifies his {{tip|ability|basic abilities}} which can be cast at no cost.

Upon entering ''All Out'', '''K'Sante''' is restored to {{as|100% '''maximum''' mana}}. His {{as|mana}} then decays to {{as|0|mana}} over the duration of the buff, after which the {{tt|amount of {{as|mana}}|Preserves the exact amount of mana, not his mana percentage at the time}} he had {{tt|prior to entering ''All Out''|After paying All Out's mana cost}} is restored.
params.description5: '''''K'Sante''' retains his {{as|'''maximum''' health}} and '''bonus''' resistances during All Out. Health lost from gaining the health threshold is '''not''' restored after the effect ends. If the target is pulled over terrain, '''K'Sante''' will {{tip|vanish}} during their displacement and reappear near the end of it.''
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tt|350|Range check for pull being eligible for displacing through terrain}}|{{tt|5000|Maximum pull radius over terrain on Summoner's Rift}}|{{tt|Global|Pull radius over terrain on non-Summoner's Rift maps}}}}
params.notes:
* ''All Out's'' cast has a {{tip|forgiveness radius}} of {{tip|er|icononly=true}} 50 units.
* If the terrain behind the target is invalid by not having an opposite side, ''All Out'' will not trigger its additional effects from pulling the target over terrain.
** The pull destination in this case would be inside terrain and thus the displacement would stop at the boundary.
* '''K'Sante''' will restore the exact amount of {{as|mana}} he had before going ''All Out'' after the buff expires.
** The amount does not change even if his {{as|'''maximum''' mana}} changes during the effect.
* '''K'Sante''' will {{tip|vanish}} after a {{fd|0.25}}-second delay (estimated), starting from the end of the cast time, if the target is pulled over terrain that is longer than 1000 units (estimated). Otherwise, for terrain less than 1000 units, the vanish is incurred as soon as the cast time completes.
* While the target is being {{tip|airborne|pulled}} over terrain, they are additionally {{tip|attach|attached}} to a missile that travels in the same trajectory as the displacement, detaching them afterwards.
** Removing the {{tip|airborne}} debuff will not cause the target to detach from the missile.
** The missile attaches the target to itself a second time at the end of the displacement, before detaching them (for a total of two attach instances).
* If the target resists the {{tip|airborne|pull}} by having a {{tip|spell shield}} or being {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}} or {{tip|displacement immune}}, '''K'Sante''' will still blink beyond the pull's end location as if the target were displaced.
* '''K'Sante's''' strike at the end of the displacement when the target is pulled over terrain does not apply {{ais|Dauntless Instinct|K'Sante}} mark.
* Going ''All Out'' does not override '''K'Sante's''' attack or movement commands if the target does not collide with terrain.
** If the target is however pulled through terrain then '''K'Sante''' will be ordered to {{tip|basic attack}} the target afterwards.
* The percentage bonus armor penetration {{tip|stacks additively}} with other sources of percentage armor penetration.{{bug|2}}
* The percentage bonus armor penetration is incorrectly displayed as normal (total) percentage armor penetration on the stats panel HUD, and stacks with it despite both being separate stat types.{{bug}}
* Since '''K'Sante''' retains the stats he "lost", any effects that scale based on those stats will calculate based on the value prior to him going ''All Out''.
** His '''base''' resistances can be reduced below 0 by his '''bonus''' resistances.
* ''All Out'' will not take into account resistances gained through % bonuses (eg. {{ri|Conditioning}}, {{bi|Mountainous Vigor}}, etc) when reducing '''K'Sante's base''' resistances.{{bug|1}}
** {{iis|Jak'Sho, The Protean}} {{nie|Voidborn Resilience}} specifically is taken into account.
* Gaining '''bonus''' health during ''All Out'' causes the health threshold to be briefly increased then reset back to its original value.
** The '''bonus''' health is still applied to his '''current''' health.
* During ''All Out's'' cast and displacement, the target's camera is locked and centered on their champion.
** For '''K'Sante''', his camera centers on him at the start of the cast time, then once again at the end of the cast time at the location of his blink behind the target, and it is not locked.
* ''All Out's'' granted {{tip|untargetability}} from the {{tip|vanish}} during the target's pull does not {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroy}} in-flight {{tip|projectiles}}.{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}

params.blurb3: {{sbc|All Out:}} '''K'Sante's''' {{as|{{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} is greatly reduced and he loses a large portion of his '''base''' {{as|{{sti|armor}}}} and {{as|{{sti|magic resistance}}}}, but gains {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, {{sti|lethality|{{as|'''bonus'''-armor penetration}}}}, and {{as|{{sti|omnivamp}}}}. During this time, his {{tip|ability|basic abilities}} are empowered and have no {{as|{{sti|mana}}}} cost.

description.plain: Active: K'Sante roots the target enemy champion for 0.5 seconds and gains displacement immunity over the cast time. He then shatters his ntofos, pulling the target to a location that is 300 units in the cast direction from their location at the time of cast, during which they are revealed, and blinking 175 units behind that location. The target is dealt physical damage near the end of the displacement and is stunned for 0.3 seconds once it ends.

description2.plain: If there is valid map-generated terrain 350 units in the cast direction from the target's location at the time of cast, the target is instead pulled to a location that is directly 450 units away from the edge of the other side of the terrain and K'Sante blinks 100 units behind that location, dealing them the physical damage near their emergence from the terrain. At the end of the displacement, they remain airborne for 0.264 seconds (0.25 seconds rounded up to the next game tick), after which they are stunned for 0.5 seconds. K'Sante strikes them after 0.132 seconds (0.125 seconds rounded up to the next game tick) into the airborne duration to deal physical damage.

description3.plain: After K'Sante blinks, he enters All Out for 15 seconds.

description4.plain: All Out: K'Sante gains a health threshold equal to 65% maximum health which cannot be modified nor exceeded by any means. Upon entering All Out, his current health is reduced to this threshold if it is above it. Additionally, his base armor and base magic resistance are reduced by 85% bonus armor and 85% bonus magic resistance, respectively. In return, he gains bonus attack speed, 50% bonus-armor penetration, and 20% omnivamp, and modifies his basic abilities which can be cast at no cost. Upon entering All Out, K'Sante is restored to 100% maximum mana. His mana then decays to 0 over the duration of the buff, after which the amount of mana he had prior to entering All Out is restored.

description5.plain: K'Sante retains his maximum health and bonus resistances during All Out. Health lost from gaining the health threshold is not restored after the effect ends. If the target is pulled over terrain, K'Sante will vanish during their displacement and reappear near the end of it.

blurb.plain: Active: K'Sante roots an enemy and then shatters his tonfas, knocking them back, blinking behind them, and dealing physical damage. If the enemy is pushed into terrain, they will be knocked over it and take additional physical damage.

blurb2.plain: The target is stunned at the end of the push, and also knocked up again if they were pushed through terrain. At the end, K'Sante goes All Out for some time.

blurb3.plain: All Out: K'Sante's maximum health is greatly reduced and he loses a large portion of his base armor and magic resistance, but gains bonus attack speed, bonus-armor penetration, and omnivamp. During this time, his basic abilities are empowered and have no mana cost.

blurb4.plain: Bonus-armor penetration affects bonus armor only.
